verdict.rationale: GitBook has its own documented OpenAPI feature: an 'Add an OpenAPI specification' docs page and interactive blocks that let users test endpoints on the page, so generating API reference pages from a spec is supported. Nothing in the evidence shows the pages update automatically when the spec changes, and the in-sync half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented automatic re-sync or refresh of API pages when the spec changes, details of how pages are generated from the spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, my API reference pages are generated from an OpenAPI spec and stay in sync when the spec changes

citations.quote: let your users test endpoints right on the page with interactive blocks
